keepAwakeDescription: Prevent screen sleep while tracking with the dashboard visible.
brightnessDescription: Only changes this app. System brightness returns when you leave.
leftHandedDescription: Place the instrument on the left in wide layouts.
nightHudDescription: Use a pure-black HUD with a bright readout for night driving.
alertOffsetDescription: The warning starts at your limit plus this margin.
calibrationDescription: Adjust future distance measurements to match a reference odometer. GPS speed and previously recorded distances stay unchanged.
autoRecordTripsDescription: Save each session you explicitly start. Finish a trip to add it to history. GPS never starts automatically.
recordRouteDescription: Keep start/end coordinates and accepted GPS points locally for the map, replay and GPX export. Turn off to save only statistics and speed samples. Existing routes remain until deleted.
backgroundTrackingDescription: After you tap Start trip, a visible location-service notification keeps GPS active outside the app. Use its Stop button to end recording. No background-location permission is requested.
economyGpsDescription: Request a fix about every 3 seconds instead of every second. Accuracy and responsiveness depend on your device.
overlayDescription: Show speed over other apps while a trip is running. Drag to move and use the corner handle to resize.
overlayPermissionBody: Android needs permission to display the speed readout over navigation and other apps. The overlay only shows this app’s speed and warning state; it does not read the content of other apps. You can hide it here or stop your trip from the notification.
backupDescription: Backups include settings, trips and any saved precise routes. Save or share them only with people and apps you trust. Nothing uploads automatically.
restoreBackupMessage: A valid backup replaces all saved trips, odometer and settings on this device. Export a backup first if you want to keep the current data. Tracking will stop before restoring.
deleteAllDataMessage: This stops tracking and permanently deletes trips, precise routes, the odometer and saved settings on this device. Files you previously exported are not deleted.
resetPreferencesMessage: Restore default display, warning and recording settings. Saved trips and the odometer are kept.
trackingHint: GPS is active. Use the trip controls or notification to stop.
sessionOnly: Local trip · saved when you finish
warningSettingsDescription: Choose a personal limit and the warnings you prefer.
enableWarningSubtitle: Show a warning above your selected limit and margin.
warningScope: Sound, vibration and speech are optional. A warning is an aid; keep your attention on the road. Device sound settings and hardware can affect audible and haptic alerts.
foregroundDisclosure: GPS starts only when you tap Start trip. With background tracking enabled, a visible notification keeps tracking when you leave the app and offers a Stop button. Trips and optional precise routes stay on this device until you delete them or explicitly export a file. No account or automatic uploads.
permissionOfflineBody: No account, no automatic uploads, and no internet needed. Trips and optional precise routes are saved on this device. You can turn route storage off, export a local backup or delete your data in Settings.
permissionControlBody: GPS starts when you tap Start trip. A visible notification can keep tracking when minimized and has a Stop button. Background tracking, route recording and warnings are controlled in Settings.
resetMessage: This stops tracking and discards the current trip. Earlier saved trips, the total odometer and calendar distance totals are kept.
failureStorage: Local data could not be loaded or saved. Please try again.
sessionRecordingOff: Trip saving is off · odometer stays on this device
